item.title: Version 4.5.0
item.description:
What's New in 4.5.0

Chawd's choreography pass — the exaggerated squash-and-stretch moves (stretch, sneeze, hiccup) are gone; every animation now moves through translation and rotation only, so the pixel art never warps. New: a full moonwalk. Walk now leaves in a random direction each time.

Since 4.4.0: respects your permission mode (no more double prompts in bypass/auto/plan), accurate session status, lands on the right window and the right display, project-local permission rules, and a rewritten hook bridge.

This update can't be verified automatically — click below to open the release page and download it directly, or run brew upgrade notch-so-good.
